metadata.phase: Revised 100-product proposal for approval; first 50 checked with explicit publication holds
metadata.scope: Research only. No website implementation, design, counts, affiliate helper or Toolkit Builder changes.

comparisons.title: OBD2 code readers and phone-based diagnosis: coverage, access and limits
comparisons.criteria: Engine/emissions reader versus phone-assisted enhanced diagnosis; verify exact generation, app and vehicle coverage. Different capabilities are not interchangeable.

comparisons.title: Scan tools: supported bidirectional functions, four-system access and wireless tablets
comparisons.criteria: VIN-level active tests, subscription terms, region, secure gateway, CAN FD and DoIP

comparisons.title: Automotive electrical test tools: meter, powered probe or battery tester
comparisons.criteria: complementary diagnostic roles; never present these as equivalent substitutes

comparisons.title: Jump starter versus battery charger: choose for the fault
comparisons.criteria: starting support versus recharging; battery chemistry, voltage, environment and package

comparisons.title: Mechanic torque wrenches: inch-pound, service and wheel ranges
comparisons.criteria: split recommendations by range, direction and fastener; no universal wheel-torque setting

comparisons.title: Mechanic socket sets: hand drive, impact and universal access
comparisons.criteria: subtables for hand-drive and impact sockets; exact kit contents, skips, drive and reach

comparisons.title: Mechanic hand tools and access kits: starter essentials versus optional upgrades
comparisons.criteria: Separate subgroups for drivers, pliers, bit sockets, pry/pick/trim tools and ratchet access; identify existing kit overlap, hand-only sockets and optional upgrades. Do not rank dissimilar tools as equivalent alternatives.

comparisons.title: Mechanic wrench sets: metric, SAE, flare-nut and long reach
comparisons.criteria: do not label SAE sets suitable for metric fittings; compare within role

comparisons.title: Cordless mechanic tools: stubby, mid/high torque and powered ratchets
comparisons.criteria: separate tool classes and battery platforms; complete usable kit cost rather than bare-tool price

comparisons.title: Brake service tools: piston retraction, lining checks and bleeding
comparisons.criteria: task-led groups; EPB procedure and ABS bleeding support separate

comparisons.title: Mechanical pullers and suspension/steering tools by service operation
comparisons.criteria: vehicle and adapter compatibility, press versus separator versus puller; exclude generic spring-compressor advice

comparisons.title: Floor jacks and jack stands: clearance, support and capacity basis
comparisons.criteria: separate lifting from supporting; exact manual, pair/individual capacity, saddle and recall check

comparisons.title: Fluid service equipment: extraction, filling and containment
comparisons.criteria: fluid-specific materials, temperatures, contamination control and exact adapters

comparisons.title: Oil filter tools: spin-on wrenches versus cartridge cap tools
comparisons.criteria: filter diameter, cap geometry, engine and socket size; current design versus old reviews

comparisons.title: Cooling-system tools: pressure test, vacuum refill and controlled flushing
comparisons.criteria: pressure limits and adapters; distinguish finding a fault from filling a system

comparisons.title: Tyre and wheel service tools: pressure, valve cores and TPMS
comparisons.criteria: gauge resolution versus accuracy; exact pressure range and TPMS vehicle coverage

comparisons.title: Engine testing and ignition-service tools: choose for the operation
comparisons.criteria: Separate compression/leakage/vacuum/fuel-pressure diagnosis from spark-plug access and gap measurement. Exact engine, plug size and adapters govern suitability; no low-pressure fuel kit for GDI/diesel.

comparisons.title: Inspection access: penlights, underhood lights, cameras, mirrors and pickup tools
comparisons.criteria: penlight, hazardous-location flashlight, rechargeable light, underhood bar and camera are distinct roles

comparisons.title: Mechanic storage: portable box, service cart or rolling workstation
comparisons.criteria: weight, tool retention, drawer loads, footprint, mobility and delivered package

comparisons.title: Workshop safety equipment: select for the assessed hazard
comparisons.criteria: task-specific protection, US markings, fit, extinguisher siting and chock limits; no kit makes all work safe

workflows.title: Automotive apprentice starter toolkit
workflows.originalValue: Stage purchases against employer requirements and tools already owned. Mark alternatives and optional upgrades; do not recommend buying every listed model.
workflows.publicationGate: Approval of revised shortlist, resolved exact-listing/specification holds, cleared images, original sourced content and functioning affiliate attribution. Batch one covers core equipment for routine service and wheel work, not every vehicle procedure or school kit.
